game_title: Off By One Autopsy – Camel Trail Race
game_concept: A strategy race set in Sand Dunes – Camel Trail, a camel trail: the oasis keeper must handle scarab swarms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Off By One Autopsy: Diagnose off-by-one failures in loops and indexes in a broken script.
theme: Sand Dunes – Camel Trail: a camel trail
core_gameplay_loop: In Camel Trail, repeat each round: Diagnose off-by-one failures in loops and indexes in a broken script. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the oasis keeper ahead. Then check the autopsy value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the caravan wagon by solving code steps involving autopsy that move the oasis keeper forward.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.25).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the caravan wagon first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 10 (extended tier): Off By One Autopsy
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Off By One Autopsy' (Week 9 slot 6), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Camel Trail'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how autopsy changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against scarab swarms in Camel Trail.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.25).
